title.zh: 对第 3873 号共和国法的修改
title.en: An Act Amending Republic Act No. 3873, Entitled an Act Changing the Name of the Bureau of Public Libraries to the National Library
title.orig: An Act Amending Republic Act No. 3873, Entitled an Act Changing the Name of the Bureau of Public Libraries to the National Library

text.en:
The title of Republic Act No. 3873 is hereby amended to read as follows:
"An Act Changing the Name of the Bureau of Public Libraries to the National Library of the Philippines".

Section 1 of Republic Act No. 3873 is hereby amended to read as follows:
"Section 1. The name of the Bureau of Public Libraries is hereby changed to that of The National Library of the Philippines."

Section 2 of Republic Act No. 3873 is hereby amended to read as follows:
"Section 2. All references to the Bureau of Public Libraries in laws, executive orders, rules and regulations shall henceforth be understood to refer to The National Library of the Philippines."

Any law, presidential decree, issuance, executive order, letter of instruction, administrative order, rule and regulation contrary to or inconsistent with the provisions of this Act is hereby repealed, modified or amended accordingly.
This Act shall take effect ten (10) days following its complete publication in any newspaper of general circulation.
